descricao_original: Stomach regions are differentiated by the ratio of the length of the gastric pits to the length of the gastric glands and by the types of gland cells present. In the cardiac region the length of gastric glands roughly equals the depth of the pits. Cardiac glands are primarily composed of mucus-secreting cells and extend to the muscularis mucosae. 200x

marcadores.explicacao_original: A mucus-secreting sheet gland covers the luminal surface and infolds to form gastric pits. Mucin in these cells is deeply eosinophilic here and appears as red-staining droplets in the apical cytoplasm of the cells.
